page_topic_one_liner: SEO tool stack guide — free essentials, all-in-one platforms, rank trackers, browser extensions, desktop crawlers, and enterprise log analysis
differentiator_vs_generic: This is a curated SEO tooling workflow guide, NOT a single-product affiliate page. Hero must show a layered tool-stack collage (GSC + crawler + rank tracker panels) representing how teams assemble diagnostics, suites, and point tools — NOT an AI chat panel or one vendor dashboard.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Three stacked SEO tool UI panels as editorial collage — top: Google Search Console performance mini-dashboard with clicks/impressions line chart blur; middle: desktop crawler sitemap tree view with URL rows and status dots; bottom-right: rank tracker grid with position trend sparklines — panels overlap with torn-paper edges
Secondary: Chrome browser extension overlay strip showing on-page meta/title audit fields (blurred text, no real brand logos)
Tertiary: small free-tool badge cluster — broken-link scan icon + meta-length preview bar (visual icons only, no tool names as text)
anti_patterns: Single Semrush/Ahrefs logo or affiliate pricing card as hero
Generic magnifying glass alone without tool UI panels
